mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.code, m.parent_id as parentId, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.menu_type as menuType, m.sort_order as sortOrder, m.visible, m.enabled, m.tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu m WHERE m.enabled = 1 AND m.tenant_id = 'default' AND ( -- 通过岗位的menu_ids字段匹配 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workposition wp WHERE wp.id = #{positionId} AND wp.tenant_id = 'default' AND FIND_IN_SET(m.id, wp.menu_ids) > 0 ) OR -- 基础菜单，所有用户都可见 m.code IN ('profile') ) ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT mf.id, mf.menu_id as menuId, mf.name, mf.code, mf.description, mf.sort_order as sortOrder, mf.enabled, mf.tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu_function mf WHERE mf.menu_id = #{menuId} AND mf.enabled = 1 AND mf.tenant_id = 'default' ORDER BY mf.sort_order ASC

SELECT id, name, code, parent_id as parentId, path, component, icon, menu_type as menuType, sort_order as sortOrder, visible, enabled, tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu WHERE enabled = 1 AND tenant_id = 'default' ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC

SELECT id, name, code, parent_id as parentId, path, component, icon, menu_type as menuType, sort_order as sortOrder, visible, enabled, tenant_id as tenantId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM menu WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = 'default'
